MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The calipers would help me check screw and washer dimensions, making them useful companions to my recent fastener assortments.",
    "The smaller NEIKO caliper with a metric readout fits my small metric fasteners better than the larger VINCA option."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Wire connectors and both heat-shrink kits assume a wiring task that my recent fastening and hanging purchases do not suggest.",
    "Filament, cutting wheels, an inspection camera, and a feeler gauge serve specific tasks I do not currently have; being workshop supplies does not make them useful to me now.",
    "I have no immediate gluing need, and a ten-pack of glue would be excessive for me."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying hardware seems to have been interpreted as interest in almost any workshop or repair supply.",
    "My assortment purchases seem to have been taken as interest in other large supply kits, even when their purpose is unrelated."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases center on fastening and hanging, especially small nuts, bolts, locking washers, and magnetic hooks.",
    "A useful next item needs a direct role alongside those supplies, such as measuring small metric hardware, rather than requiring a separate project."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in hardware but stretched it into unrelated workshop tasks, with the smaller metric caliper providing the clearest practical match."
}
